impact.text: This allows attackers to use any malicious token as the quote asset parameter.

precondition_sources.text: The addRewards call supplies a malicious token as the quoteAsset parameter.

intent_sources.text: addRewards must validate that the quoteAsset parameter matches the stored rs.quoteAsset in the reward pool.
